correction: Electron renderer memory is app.getAppMetrics() matched by webContents.getOSProcessId(), then memory.workingSetSize, in Kilobytes. The tested metadata inaccurately names getProcessMemoryInfo(). Actual measurements and comparisons are unchanged.
elapsed_ms_note: Electron starts at its main-module performance.now(); Tauri starts at native run() Instant. Neither uses the external process-creation instant. These elapsed values do not establish startup or speed superiority.
